morceaux.1: Fasti III P. OVIDI NASONIS FASTORVM LIBER TERTIVS
morceaux.2:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">Bellice, depositis clipeo paulisper et hasta,</l>
  <l n="2">Mars, ades et nitidas casside solve comas.</l>
  <l n="3">forsitan ipse roges quid sit cum Marte poetae:</l>
  <l n="4">a te qui canitur nomina mensis habet.</l>
  <l n="5">ipse vides manibus peragi fera bella <name type="deity">Minervae</name>:</l>
  <l n="6">num minus ingenuis artibus illa vacat?</l>
  <l n="7"><name type="deity">Palladis</name> exemplo ponendae tempora sume</l>
  <l n="8">cuspidis: invenies et quod inermis agas.</l>
  <l n="9">tum quoque inermis eras, cum te Romana sacerdos</l>
  <l n="10">cepit, ut huic urbi semina magna dares.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="11"><persName>Silvia</persName> <persName>Vestalis</persName> (quid enim vetat inde moveri?)</l>
  <l n="12">sacra lavaturas mane petebat aquas.</l>
  <l n="13">ventum erat ad molli declivem tramite ripam;</l>
  <l n="14">ponitur e summa fictilis urna coma:</l>
  <l n="15">fessa resedit humo, ventosque accepit aperto</l>
  <l n="16">pectore, turbatas restituitque comas.</l>
  <l n="17">dum sedet, umbrosae <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">salices</name> volucresque canorae</l>
  <l n="18">fecerunt somnos et leve murmur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aquae</name>;</l>
  <l n="19">blanda quies furtim victis obrepsit ocellis,</l>
  <l n="20">et cadit a mento languida facta manus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="21"><name type="deity">Mars</name> videt hanc visamque cupit potiturque cupita,</l>
  <l n="22">et sua divina furta fefellit ope.</l>
  <l n="23">somnus abit, iacet ipsa gravis; iam scilicet intra</l>
  <l n="24">viscera Romanae conditor urbis erat.</l>
  <l n="25">languida consurgit, nec scit cur languida surgat,</l>
  <l n="26">et peragit tales arbore nixa sonos:</l>
  <l n="27">'utile sit faustumque, precor, quod imagine somni</l>
  <l n="28">vidimus: an somno clarius illud erat?</l>
  <l n="29">ignibus Iliacis aderam, cum lapsa capillis</l>
  <l n="30">decidit ante sacros lanea vitta focos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="31">inde duae pariter, visu mirabile, <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">palmae</name></l>
  <l n="32">surgunt: ex illis altera maior erat,</l>
  <l n="33">et gravibus ramis totum protexerat orbem,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.3:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="33">contigeratque sua sidera summa coma.</l>
  <l n="34">ecce meus ferrum patruus molitur in illas:</l>
  <l n="35">terreor admonitu, corque timore micat.</l>
  <l n="36"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Martia</name>, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">picus</name>, avis gemino pro stipite pugnant</l>
  <l n="37">et <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lupa</name>: tuta per hos utraque palma fuit.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="38">dixerat, et plenam non firmis viribus urnam</l>
  <l n="39">sustulit: implerat, dum sua visa refert.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="40">interea crescente <persName>Remo</persName>, crescente <persName>Quirino</persName>,</l>
  <l n="41">caelesti tumidus pondere venter erat.</l>
  <l n="42">quo minus emeritis exiret cursibus annus</l>
  <l n="43">restabant nitido iam duo signa deo:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="44"><persName>Silvia</persName> fit mater; <placeName>Vestae</placeName> simulacra feruntur</l>
  <l n="45">virgineas oculis opposuisse manus.</l>
  <l n="46">ara deae certe tremuit pariente ministra,</l>
  <l n="47">et subiit cineres territa flamma suos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="48">hoc ubi cognovit contemptor <persName>Amulius</persName> aequi</l>
  <l n="49">(nam raptas fratri victor habebat opes),</l>
  <l n="50">amne iubet mergi geminos. scelus unda refugit:</l>
  <l n="51">in sicca pueri destituuntur humo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="52">lacte quis infantes nescit crevisse ferino,</l>
  <l n="53">et <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">picum</name> expositis saepe tulisse cibos?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="54">non ego te, tantae nutrix <persName>Larentia</persName> gentis,</l>
  <l n="55">nec taceam vestras, <persName>Faustule</persName> pauper, opes:</l>
  <l n="56">vester honos veniet, cum <foreign xml:lang="la">Larentalia</foreign> dicam:</l>
  <l n="57">acceptus geniis illa <foreign xml:lang="la">December</foreign> habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="58"><persName>Martia</persName> ter senos proles adoleverat annos,</l>
  <l n="59">et suberat flavae iam nova barba comae:</l>
  <l n="60">omnibus agricolis armentorumque magistris</l>
  <l n="61"><placeName>Iliadae</placeName> fratres iura petita dabant.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="62">saepe domum veniunt praedonum sanguine laeti</l>
  <l n="63">et redigunt actos in sua rura boves.</l>
  <l n="64">ut genus audierunt, animos pater editus auget,</l>
  <l n="65">et pudet in paucis nomen habere casis,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.4: Halieutica Romuleoque cadit traiectus Amulius ense, regnaque longaevo restituuntur avo. moenia conduntur, quae, quamvis parva fuerunt, non tamen expediit transiluisse Remo. iam, modo quae fuerant silvae pecorumque recessus, urbs erat, aeternae cum pater urbis ait: 'arbiter armorum, de cuius sanguine natus credor et, ut credar, pignora multa dabo, a te principium Romano dicimus anno: primus de patrio nomine mensis erit.' vox rata fit, patrioque vocat de nomine mensem: dicitur haec pietas grata fuisse deo. et tamen ante omnes Martem coluere priores; hoc dederat studiis bellica turba suis. Pallada Cecropidae, Minoia Creta Dianam, Volcanum tellus Hypsipylaea colit, Iunonem Sparte Pelopeiadesque Mycenae, pinigerum Fauni Maenalis ora caput: Mars Latio venerandus erat, quia praesidet armis; arma ferae genti remque decusque dabant. quod si forte vacas, peregrinos inspice fastos: mensis in his etiam nomine Martis erit. tertius Albanis, quintus fuit ille Faliscis, sextus apud populos, Hernica terra, tuos; inter Aricinos Albanaque tempora constat factaque Telegoni moenia celsa manu; quintum Laurentes, bis quintum Aequiculus acer, a tribus hunc primum turba Curensis habet; et tibi cum proavis, miles Paeligne, Sabinis convenit; huic genti quartus utrique deus. Romulus, hos omnes ut vinceret ordine saltem, sanguinis auctori tempora prima dedit. nec totidem veteres, quot nunc, habuere Kalendas:
morceaux.5:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="100">ille minor geminis mensibus annus erat.</l>
  <l n="101">nondum tradiderat victas victoribus artes</l>
  <l n="102">Graecia, facundum sed male forte genus:</l>
  <l n="103">qui bene pugnabat, Romanam noverat artem;</l>
  <l n="104">mittere qui poterat pila, disertus erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="105">quis tunc aut <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Hyadas</name> aut <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Pliadas</name> <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Atlanteas</name></l>
  <l n="106">senserat, aut geminos esse sub axe polos,</l>
  <l n="107">esse duas <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Arctos</name>, quarum <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Cynosura</name> petatur</l>
  <l n="108"><name type="placeName">Sidoniis</name>, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Helicen</name> <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Graia</name> carina notet,</l>
  <l n="109">signaque quae longo frater percenseat anno,</l>
  <l n="110">ire per haec uno mense sororis equos?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="111">libera currebant et inobservata per annum</l>
  <l n="112">sidera; constabat sed tamen esse deos.</l>
  <l n="113">non illi caelo labentia signa tenebant,</l>
  <l n="114">sed sua, quae magnum perdere crimen erat,</l>
  <l n="115">illa quidem <foreign xml:lang="la">e</foreign> feno, sed erat reverentia feno</l>
  <l n="116">quantam nunc <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aquilas</name> cernis habere tuas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="117">pertica suspensos portabat longa maniplos,</l>
  <l n="118">unde maniplaris nomina miles habet.</l>
  <l n="119">ergo animi indociles et adhuc ratione carentes</l>
  <l n="120">mensibus egerunt lustra minora decem.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="121">annus erat decimum cum luna receperat orbem:</l>
  <l n="122">hic numerus magno tunc in honore fuit,</l>
  <l n="123">seu quia tot digiti, per quos numerare solemus,</l>
  <l n="124">seu quia bis quinto femina mense parit,</l>
  <l n="125">seu quod adusque decem numero crescente venitur,</l>
  <l n="126">principium spatiis sumitur inde novis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="127">inde patres centum denos secrevit in orbes</l>
  <l n="128">Romulus, hastatos instituitque decem,</l>
  <l n="129">et totidem princeps, totidem pilanus habebat</l>
  <l n="130">corpora, legitimo quique merebat equo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="131">quin etiam partes totidem Titiensibus ille,</l>
  <l n="132">quosque vocant Ramnes, Luceribusque dedit.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.6:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="133">adsuetos igitur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">numeros</name> servavit in anno;</l>
  <l n="134">hoc luget spatio femina maesta virum.</l>
  <l n="135">neu dubites primae fuerint quin ante Kalendae</l>
  <l n="136">Martis, ad haec animum signa referre potes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="137">laurea flaminibus quae toto perstitit anno</l>
  <l n="138">tollitur, et frondes sunt in honore novae;</l>
  <l n="139">ianua tum regis posita viret arbore Phoebi;</l>
  <l n="140">ante tuas fit idem, <placeName>Curia prisca</placeName>, fores.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="141">Vesta quoque ut folio niteat velata recenti,</l>
  <l n="142">cedit ab Iliacis laurea cana focis.</l>
  <l n="143">adde quod arcana fieri novus ignis in aede</l>
  <l n="144">dicitur, et vires flamma refecta capit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="145">nec mihi parva fides annos hinc isse priores</l>
  <l n="146">Anna quod hoc coepta est mense Perenna coli.</l>
  <l n="147">hinc etiam veteres initi memorantur honores</l>
  <l n="148">ad spatium belli, perfide Poene, tui.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="149">denique quintus ab hoc fuerat Quintilis, et inde</l>
  <l n="150">incipit a numero nomina quisquis habet.</l>
  <l n="151">primus, oliviferis Romam deductus ab arvis,</l>
  <l n="152"><persName>Pompilius</persName> menses sensit abesse duos,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="133">sive hoc a Samio doctus, qui posse renasci</l>
  <l n="134">nos putat, <name type="deity">Egeria</name> sive monente sua.</l>
  <l n="135">sed tamen errabant etiam nunc tempora, donec</l>
  <l n="136">Caesaris in multis haec quoque cura fuit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="157">non haec ille deus tantaeque propaginis auctor</l>
  <l n="158">credidit officiis esse minora suis,</l>
  <l n="159">promissumque sibi voluit praenoscere caelum</l>
  <l n="160">nec deus ignotas hospes inire domos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="161">ille moras solis, quibus in sua signa rediret,</l>
  <l n="162">traditur exactis disposuisse notis;</l>
  <l n="163">is decies senos ter centum et quinque diebus</l>
  <l n="164">iunxit et a pleno tempora quinta die.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.7:
hic anni modus est: in lustrum accedere debet, quae consummatur partibus, una dies.

morceaux.8:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="170">Si licet occultos monitus audire deorum</l>
  <l n="171">vatibus, ut certe fama licere putat,</l>
  <l n="172"><persName>cum sis</persName> officiis, <name type="deity">Gradive</name>, virilibus aptus,</l>
  <l n="173">dic mihi matronae cur tua festa colant.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="174">sic ego. sic posita dixit mihi casside <name type="deity">Mavors</name></l>
  <l n="175">(sed tamen in dextra missilis hasta fuit):</l>
  <l n="176">'nunc primum studiis pacis deus utilis armis</l>
  <l n="177">advocor, et gressus in nova castra fero.</l>
  <l n="178">nec piget incepti: iuvat hac quoque parte morari,</l>
  <l n="179">hoc solam ne se posse <name type="deity">Minerva</name> putet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="180">disce, <name type="person">Latinorum</name> vates operose dierum,</l>
  <l n="181">quod petis, et memori pectore dicta nota.</l>
  <l n="182">parva fuit, si prima velis elementa referre,</l>
  <l n="183"><placeName>Roma</placeName>, sed in parva spes tamen huius erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="184">moenia iam stabant, populis angusta futuris,</l>
  <l n="185">credita sed turbae tum nimis ampla suae.</l>
  <l n="186">quae fuerit nostri si quaeris regia nati,</l>
  <l n="187">aspice de <name type="plant">canna</name> straminibusque domum.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="188">in stipula placidi capiebat munera somni,</l>
  <l n="189">et tamen ex illo venit in astra toro.</l>
  <l n="190">iamque loco maius nomen Romanus habebat,</l>
  <l n="191">nec coniunx illi nec socer ullus erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="192">spernebant generos inopes vicinia dives,</l>
  <l n="193">et male credebar sanguinis auctor ego.</l>
  <l n="194">in stabulis habitasse et oves pavisse nocebat</l>
  <l n="195">iugeraque inculti pauca tenere soli.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="196">cum pare quaeque suo coeunt volucresque feraeque</l>
  <l n="197">atque aliquam de qua procreet <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">anguis</name> habet.</l>
  <l n="198">extremis dantur conubia gentibus: at quae</l>
  <l n="199"><placeName>Romano</placeName> vellet nubere nulla fuit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="200">indolui patriamque dedi tibi, <persName>Romule</persName>, mentem.</l>
  <l n="201">"tolle preces", dixi "quod petis arma dabunt."</l>
  <l n="202">festa parat <name type="deity">Conso</name>. <name type="deity">Consus</name> tibi cetera dicet,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.9:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="200">illa facta die dum sua sacra <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canet</name>.</l>
  <l n="201">intumuere <placeName>Cures</placeName> et quos dolor attigit idem:</l>
  <l n="202">tum primum generis intulit arma <persName>socer</persName>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="203">iamque fere raptae matrum quoque nomen habebant,</l>
  <l n="204">tractaque erant longa bella propinqua mora:</l>
  <l n="205">conveniunt nuptae dictam <name type="deity">Iunonis</name> in aedem,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="206">quas inter mea sic est nurus ausa loqui:</l>
  <l n="207">"o pariter raptae, quoniam hoc commune tenemus,</l>
  <l n="208">non ultra lente possumus esse piae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="209">stant acies: sed utra di sint pro parte rogandi</l>
  <l n="210">eligite; hinc coniunx, hinc pater arma tenet.</l>
  <l n="211">quaerendum est viduae fieri malitis an orbae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="212">consilium vobis forte piumque dabo."</l>
  <l n="213">consilium dederat: parent, crinesque resolvunt</l>
  <l n="214">maestaque funerea corpora veste tegunt.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="215">iam steterant acies ferro mortique paratae,</l>
  <l n="216">iam lituus pugnae signa daturus erat,</l>
  <l n="217">cum raptae veniunt inter patresque virosque,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="218">inque sinu natos, pignora cara, tenent.</l>
  <l n="219">ut medium campi scissis tetigere capillis,</l>
  <l n="220">in terram posito procubuere genu;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="221">et, quasi sentirent, blando clamore nepotes</l>
  <l n="222">tendebant ad avos bracchia parva suos.</l>
  <l n="223">qui poterat, clamabat avum tum denique visum,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="224">et, qui vix poterat, posse coactus erat.</l>
  <l n="225">tela viris animique cadunt, gladiisque remotis</l>
  <l n="226">dant soceri generis accipiuntque manus,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="227">laudatasque tenent natas, scutoque nepotem</l>
  <l n="228">fert avus: hic scuti dulcior usus erat.</l>
  <l n="229">inde ~diem quae prima~ meas celebrare <foreign xml:lang="la">Kalendas</foreign></l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="230"><placeName>Oebaliae</placeName> matres non leve munus habent,</l>
  <l n="33">aut quia committi strictis mucronibus ausae</l>
</lg>
morceaux.10:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="231">finierant lacrimis Martia bella suis;</l>
  <l n="232">vel quod erat de me feliciter Ilia mater</l>
  <l n="233">rite colunt matres sacra diemque meum.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="234">quid quod hiems adoperta gelu tum denique cedit,</l>
  <l n="235">et pereunt lapsae sole tepente nives;</l>
  <l n="236">arboribus redeunt detonsae frigore frondes,</l>
  <l n="237">uvidaque in tenero palmite gemma tumet;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="238">quaeque diu latuit, nunc, se qua tollat in auras,</l>
  <l n="239">fertilis occultas invenit herba vias?</l>
  <l n="240">nunc fecundus ager, pecoris nunc hora creandi,</l>
  <l n="241">nunc avis in ramo tecta laremque parat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="242">tempora iure colunt Latiae fecunda parentes,</l>
  <l n="243">quarum militiam votaque partus habet.</l>
  <l n="244">adde quod, excubias ubi rex Romanus agebat,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="245">qui nunc Esquilias nomina collis habet,</l>
  <l n="246">illic a nuribus Iunoni templa Latinis</l>
  <l n="247">hac sunt, si memini, publica facta die.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="248">quid moror et variis onero tua pectora causis?</l>
  <l n="249">eminet ante oculos quod petis ecce tuos.</l>
  <l n="250">mater amat nuptas: matris me turba frequentat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="251">haec nos praecipue tam pia causa decet.'</l>
  <l n="252">ferte deae flores: gaudet florentibus herbis</l>
  <l n="253">haec dea; de tenero cingite flore caput:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="254">dicite 'tu nobis lucem, Lucina, dedisti':</l>
  <l n="255">dicite 'tu voto parturientis ades.'</l>
  <l n="256">siqua tamen gravida est, resoluto crine precetur</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="257">ut solvat partus molliter illa suos.</l>
  <l n="258">Quis mihi nunc dicet quare caelestia Martis</l>
  <l n="259">arma ferant Salii Mamuriumque canant?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="260">nympha, mone, nemori stagnoque operata Dianae;</l>
  <l n="261">nympha, Numae coniunx, ad tua facta veni.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="262">vallis Aricinae silva praecinctus opaca</l>
  <l n="263">est lacus, antiqua religione sacer;</l>
</lg>
morceaux.11:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="265">hic latet <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Hippolytus</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">loris</name> direptus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equorum</name>,</l>
  <l n="266">unde nemus nullis illud aditur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equis</name>.</l>
  <l n="267">licia dependent longas velantia saepes,</l>
  <l n="268">et posita est meritae multa tabella <name type="deity">deae</name>.</l>
  <l n="269">saepe potens voti, frontem redimita coronis,</l>
  <l n="270">femina lucentes portat ab <placeName>Urbe</placeName> faces.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="271">regna tenent fortes manibus pedibusque fugaces,</l>
  <l n="272">et perit exemplo postmodo quisque suo.</l>
  <l n="273">defluit incerto lapidosus murmure rivus:</l>
  <l n="274">saepe, sed exiguis haustibus, inde bibi.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="275"><name type="deity">Egeria</name> est quae praebet aquas, <name type="deity">dea</name> grata <name type="deity">Camenis</name>:</l>
  <l n="276">illa <persName>Numae</persName> coniunx consiliumque fuit.</l>
  <l n="277">principio nimium promptos ad bella <persName>Quirites</persName></l>
  <l n="278">molliri placuit iure deumque metu.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="279">inde datae leges, ne firmior omnia posset,</l>
  <l n="280">coeptaque sunt pure tradita sacra coli.</l>
  <l n="281">exuitur feritas, armisque potentius aequum est,</l>
  <l n="282">et cum cive pudet conseruisse manus,</l>
  <l n="283">atque aliquis, modo trux, visa iam vertitur ara</l>
  <l n="284">vinaque dat tepidis farraque salsa focis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="285">ecce <name type="deity">deum</name> genitor rutilas per nubila flammas</l>
  <l n="286">spargit, et effusis aethera siccat aquis.</l>
  <l n="287">non alias missi cecidere frequentius ignes:</l>
  <l n="288">rex pavet et volgi pectora terror habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="289">cui <name type="deity">dea</name> 'ne nimium terrere: piabile fulmen</l>
  <l n="290">est' ait 'et saevi flectitur ira <name type="deity">Iovis</name>.</l>
  <l n="291">sed poterunt ritum <persName>Picus</persName> <persName>Faunus</persName>que piandi</l>
  <l n="292">tradere, <persName>Romani</persName> numen utrumque soli.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="293">nec sine vi tradent: adhibe tu vincula captis';</l>
  <l n="294">atque ita qua possint edidit arte capi.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="295">lucus <placeName>Aventino</placeName> suberat niger <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">ilicis</name> umbra,</l>
  <l n="296">quo posses viso dicere 'numen inest'.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.12:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="297">in medio gramen, <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">muscus</name>-que <foreign xml:lang="la">adoperta</foreign> <foreign xml:lang="la">virenti</foreign></l>
  <l n="298"><name type="plant" xml:lang="la">manabat</name> saxo vena perennis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aquae</name>;</l>
  <l n="299">inde fere soli <persName>Faunus</persName> <persName>Picus</persName>-que bibebant:</l>
  <l n="300">huc venit et fonti rex <persName>Numa</persName> mactat <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ovem</name>,</l>
  <l n="301">plenaque odorati disponit pocula <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Bacchi</name>,</l>
  <l n="302">cumque suis antro conditus ipse latet.</l>
  <l n="303">ad solitos veniunt silvestria numina fontes</l>
  <l n="304">et relevant multo pectora sicca <foreign xml:lang="la">mero</foreign>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="305"><name type="plant" xml:lang="la">vina</name> quies sequitur: gelido <persName>Numa</persName> prodit ab antro</l>
  <l n="306">vinclaque sopitas addit in arta manus.</l>
  <l n="307">somnus ut abscessit, pugnando vincula temptant</l>
  <l n="308">rumpere; pugnantes fortius illa tenent.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="309">tum <persName>Numa</persName>: 'di nemorum, factis ignoscite nostris</l>
  <l n="310">si scelus ingenio scitis abesse meo,</l>
  <l n="311">quoque modo possit <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">fulmen</name> monstrate piari.'</l>
  <l n="312">sic <persName>Numa</persName>; sic quatiens cornua <persName>Faunus</persName> ait:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="313">'magna petis, nec quae monitu tibi discere nostro</l>
  <l n="314">fas sit: habent fines numina nostra suos.</l>
  <l n="315">di sumus agrestes et qui dominemur in altis</l>
  <l n="316">montibus; arbitrium est in sua tecta <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iovi</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="317">hunc tu non poteris per te deducere <foreign xml:lang="la">caelo</foreign>,</l>
  <l n="318">at poteris nostra forsitan usus ope.'</l>
  <l n="319">dixerat haec <persName>Faunus</persName>; par est sententia <persName>Pici</persName>.</l>
  <l n="320">'deme tamen nobis vincula', <persName>Picus</persName> ait,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="321"><name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iuppiter</name> huc veniet, valida perductus ab arte:</l>
  <l n="322"><foreign xml:lang="la">nubila</foreign> promissi <name type="placeName">Styx</name> mihi testis erit.'</l>
  <l n="323">emissi laqueis quid agant, quae carmina dicant,</l>
  <l n="324">quaque trahant superis sedibus arte <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iovem</name></l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="325">scire nefas <foreign xml:lang="la">homini</foreign>. nobis concessa canentur</l>
  <l n="326">et quae pio dici vatis ab ore licet.</l>
  <l n="327">eliciunt <foreign xml:lang="la">caelo</foreign> te, <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iuppiter</name>; unde minores</l>
  <l n="328">nunc quoque te celebrant <foreign xml:lang="la">Elicium</foreign>-que vocant.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.13:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="330">constat <name type="placeName">Aventinae</name> tremuisse cacumina <name type="plant">silvae</name>,</l>
  <l n="331">terraque subsedit pondere pressa <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iovis</name>:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="332">corda micant regis totoque e corpore sanguis</l>
  <l n="333">fugit et hirsutae deriguere comae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="334">ut rediit animus, 'da certa <foreign xml:lang="la">piamina</foreign>' dixit</l>
  <l n="335">'fulminis, altorum rexque paterque <name type="deity">deum</name>,</l>
  <l n="336">si tua contigimus manibus donaria puris,</l>
  <l n="337">hoc quoque quod petitur si pia lingua rogat.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="338">adnuit oranti, sed verum ambage remota</l>
  <l n="339">abdidit et dubio terruit ore virum.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="340">'caede caput' dixit; cui rex 'parebimus' inquit;</l>
  <l n="341">'caedenda est hortis eruta <name type="plant">cepa</name> meis.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="342">addidit hic '<name type="animal" xml:lang="la">hominis</name>'; 'sumes' ait ille 'capillos.'</l>
  <l n="343">postulat hic animam; cui <persName>Numa</persName> 'piscis' ait.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="344">risit, et 'his' inquit 'mea tela procures,</l>
  <l n="345">o vir conloquio non abigende <name type="deity">deum</name>.</l>
  <l n="346">sed tibi, protulerit cum totum crastinus orbem</l>
  <l n="337"><name type="deity">Cynthius</name>, imperii pignora certa dabo.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="348">dixit et ingenti tonitru super aethera motum</l>
  <l n="349">fertur, adorantem destituitque <persName>Numam</persName>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="350">ille redit laetus memoratque <persName>Quiritibus</persName> acta:</l>
  <l n="351">tarda venit dictis difficilisque fides.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="352">'at certe credemur' ait 'si verba sequetur</l>
  <l n="353">exitus: en audi crastina, quisquis ades.</l>
  <l n="354">protulerit terris cum totum <name type="deity">Cynthius</name> orbem,</l>
  <l n="355"><name type="deity">Iuppiter</name> imperii pignora certa dabit.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="356">discedunt dubii, promissaque tarda videntur,</l>
  <l n="357">dependetque fides a veniente die.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="358">mollis erat tellus rorata mane <foreign xml:lang="la">pruina</foreign>:</l>
  <l n="359">ante sui populus limina regis adest.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="360">prodit et in solio medius consedit acerno;</l>
  <l n="361">innumeri circa stantque silentque viri.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="362">ortus erat summo tantummodo margine <name type="deity">Phoebus</name>:</l>
</lg>
morceaux.14:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="361">sollicitae mentes speque metuque pavent.</l>
  <l n="362">constitit atque caput niveo velatus amictu</l>
  <l n="363">iam bene dis notas sustulit ille manus,</l>
  <l n="364">atque ita 'tempus adest promissi muneris' inquit;</l>
  <l n="365">pollicitam dictis, <name type="deity">Iuppiter</name>, adde fidem.'</l>
  <l n="366">dum loquitur, totum iam sol emoverat orbem,</l>
  <l n="367">et gravis aetherio venit ab axe fragor.</l>
  <l n="368">ter tonuit sine nube deus, tria fulgura misit.</l>
  <l n="369">credite dicenti: mira sed acta loquor:</l>
  <l n="370">a media caelum regione dehiscere coepit:</l>
  <l n="371">summisere oculos cum duce turba suo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="372">ecce levi scutum versatum leniter aura</l>
  <l n="373">decidit: a populo clamor ad astra venit.</l>
  <l n="374">tollit humo munus caesa prius ille iuvenca</l>
  <l n="375">quae dederat nulli colla premenda iugo,</l>
  <l n="376">idque ancile vocat, quod ab omni parte recisum est,</l>
  <l n="377">quaque notes oculis angulus omnis abest.</l>
  <l n="378">tum, memor imperii sortem consistere in illo,</l>
  <l n="379">consilium multae calliditatis init:</l>
  <l n="380">plura iubet fieri simili caelata figura,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="381">error ut ante oculos insidiantis eat.</l>
  <l n="382"><persName>Mamurius</persName>, morum fabraene exactior artis</l>
  <l n="383">difficile est, illud, dicere, clausit opus.</l>
  <l n="384">cui <persName>Numa</persName> munificus 'facti pete praemia' dixit:</l>
  <l n="385">'si mea nota fides, inrita nulla petes.'</l>
  <l n="386">iam dederat <persName>Saliis</persName> a saltu nomina ducta</l>
  <l n="387">armaque et ad certos verba canenda modos;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="388">tum sic <persName>Mamurius</persName>: 'merces mihi gloria detur,</l>
  <l n="389">nominaque extremo carmine nostra sonent.'</l>
  <l n="390">inde sacerdotes operi promissa vetusto</l>
  <l n="391">praemia persolvunt <persName>Mamurium</persName>que vocant.</l>
  <l n="392"><persName>Nubere</persName> siqua voles, quamvis properabitis ambo,</l>
  <l n="393">differ; habent parvae commoda magna morae.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.15:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="395">arma movent pugnas, pugna est aliena maritis;</l>
  <l n="396">condita cum fuerint, aptius omen erit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="397">His etiam coniunx <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Apicati</name> cincta <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Dialis</name></l>
  <l n="398">lucibus impexas debet habere comas.</l>
</lg>

<pb n="2"/>
<pb n="3"/>

<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="399">Tertia nox de mense suos ubi moverit ortus</l>
  <l n="400">conditus e geminis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Piscibus</name> alter erit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="401">nam duo sunt: <foreign xml:lang="la">Austris</foreign> hic est, <foreign xml:lang="la">Aquilonibus</foreign> ille</l>
  <l n="402">proximus; a vento nomen uterque tenet.</l>
</lg>

<pb n="4"/>

<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="403">Cum croceis rorare genis <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Tithonia</name> coniunx</l>
  <l n="404">coeperit et quintae tempora lucis aget,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="405">sive est <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Arctophylax</name>, sive est piger ille <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Bootes</name>,</l>
  <l n="406">mergetur visus effugietque tuos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="407">at non effugiet <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Vindemitor</name>: hoc quoque causam</l>
  <l n="408">unde trahat sidus parva docere mora est.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="409"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Ampelon</name> intonsum satyro nymphaque creatum</l>
  <l n="410">fertur in Ismariis <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Bacchus</name> amasse iugis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="411">tradidit huic vitem pendentem frondibus ulmi,</l>
  <l n="412">quae nunc de puero nomine nomen habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="413">dum legit in ramo pictas temerarius uvas,</l>
  <l n="414">decidit: amissum <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Liber</name> in astra tulit.</l>
</lg>

<pb n="5"/>
<pb n="6"/>
morceaux.16:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="417">Sextus ubi <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Oceano</name> clivosum scandit <placeName>Olympum</placeName></l>
  <l n="418"><persName>Phoebus</persName> et alatis aethera carpit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equis</name>,</l>
  <l n="419">quisquis ades castaeque colis penetralia <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Vestae</name>,</l>
  <l n="420">gratare, <placeName>Iliacis</placeName> turaque pone focis.</l>
  <l n="421"><persName>Caesaris</persName> innumeris, quos maluit ille mereri,</l>
  <l n="422">accessit titulis pontificalis honor.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="423">ignibus aeternis aeterni numina praesunt</l>
  <l n="424"><persName>Caesaris</persName>: imperii pignora iuncta vides.</l>
  <l n="425">di veteris <placeName>Troiae</placeName>, dignissima praeda ferenti,</l>
  <l n="426">qua gravis <persName>Aeneas</persName> tutus ab hoste fuit,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="427">ortus ab <persName>Aenea</persName> tangit cognata <persName>sacerdos</persName></l>
  <l n="428">numina: cognatum, <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Vesta</name>, tuere caput.</l>
  <l n="429">quos sancta fovet ille manu, bene vivitis, ignes:</l>
  <l n="430">vivite inexstincti, flammaque duxque, precor.</l>
</lg>
<pb n="7"/>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l>B NON : F</l>
</lg>
morceaux.17:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="431">Una <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Marti</name> <name type="deity">Nonis</name>, sacrata quod illis</l>
  <l n="432">templa putant lucos <name type="deity">Veiovis</name> ante duos.</l>
  <l n="433"><persName>Romulus</persName>, ut saxo lucum circumdedit alto,</l>
  <l n="434">'quilibet huc' inquit 'confuge; tutus eris.'</l>
  <l n="435">o quam de tenui <persName>Romanus</persName> origine crevit,</l>
  <l n="436">turba vetus quam non invidiosa fuit!</l>
  <l n="437">ne tamen ignaro novitas tibi nominis obstet,</l>
  <l n="438">disce quis iste deus, curve vocetur ita.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="439"><name type="deity">Iuppiter</name> est iuvenis: iuvenales aspice voltus;</l>
  <l n="440">aspice deinde manum: fulmina nulla tenet.</l>
  <l n="441">fulmina post ausos caelum adfectare <foreign xml:lang="la">Gigantas</foreign></l>
  <l n="442">sumpta <name type="deity">Iovi</name>: primo tempore inermis erat;</l>
  <l n="439">ignibus <foreign xml:lang="la">Ossa</foreign> novis et <foreign xml:lang="la">Pelion</foreign> altius <foreign xml:lang="la">Ossa</foreign></l>
  <l n="440">arsit et in solida fixus <foreign xml:lang="la">Olympus</foreign> humo.</l>
  <l n="443">stat quoque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">capra</name> simul: nymphae pavisse feruntur</l>
  <l n="444"><foreign xml:lang="la">Cretides</foreign>, infanti lac dedit illa <name type="deity">Iovi</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="445">nunc vocor ad nomen: vegrandia farra coloni</l>
  <l n="446">quae male creverunt, vescaque parva vocant;</l>
  <l n="447">vis ea si verbi est, cur non ego <name type="deity">Veiovis</name> aedem</l>
  <l n="448">aedem non magni suspicer esse <name type="deity">Iovis</name>?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="449">Iamque ubi caeruleum variabunt sidera caelum,</l>
  <l n="450">suspice: <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Gorgonei</name> colla videbis equi.</l>
  <l n="451">creditur hic caesae gravida cervice <foreign xml:lang="la">Medusae</foreign></l>
  <l n="452">sanguine respersis prosiluisse iubis.</l>
  <l n="453">huic supra nubes et subter sidera lapso</l>
  <l n="454">caelum pro terra, pro pede pinna fuit;</l>
  <l n="455">iamque indignanti nova frena receperat ore</l>
  <l n="456">cum levis <foreign xml:lang="la">Aonias</foreign> ungula fodit aquas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="457">nunc fruitur caelo, quod pinnis ante petebat,</l>
  <l n="458">et nitidus stellis quinque decemque micat.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.18:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="461">Protinus aspicies venienti nocte <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Coronam</name> </l>
  <l n="462"><persName>Cnosida</persName>: <persName>Theseo</persName> crimine facta dea est.</l>
  <l n="463">iam bene periuro mutarat coniuge <name type="deity">Bacchum</name> </l>
  <l n="464">quae dedit ingrato fila legenda viro;</l>
  <l n="465">sorte tori gaudens 'quid flebam rustica?' dixit;</l>
  <l n="466">'utiliter nobis perfidus ille fuit.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="467">interea <name type="deity">Liber</name> depexos crinibus <name type="placeName">Indos</name>   <pb n="465"/></l>
  <l n="468">vicit, et <foreign xml:lang="la">Eoo</foreign> dives ab orbe redit.</l>
  <l n="469">inter captivas facie praestante puellas</l>
  <l n="470">grata nimis <name type="deity">Baccho</name> filia regis erat.</l>
  <l n="471">flebat amans coniunx, spatiataque litore curvo</l>
  <l n="472">edidit incultis talia verba comis:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="473"><quote>en iterum, fluctus, similes audite querellas.</quote></l>
  <l n="474"><quote>en iterum lacrimas accipe, harena, meas.</quote></l>
  <l n="475">dicebam, memini, "<quote>periure et perfide <persName>Theseu</persName>!</quote>"</l>
  <l n="476">ille abiit, eadem crimina <name type="deity">Bacchus</name> habet.</l>
  <l n="477">nunc quoque "<quote>nulla viro</quote>" clamabo "<quote>femina credat</quote>";</l>
  <l n="478">nomine mutato causa relata mea est.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="479">o utinam mea sors qua primum coeperat isset,</l>
  <l n="480">iamque ego praesenti tempore nulla forem.</l>
  <l n="481">quid me desertis morituram, <name type="deity">Liber</name>, harenis</l>
  <l n="482">servabas? potui dedoluisse semel.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="483"><name type="deity">Bacche</name> levis leviorque tuis, quae tempora cingunt,</l>
  <l n="484">frondibus, in lacrimas cognite <name type="deity">Bacche</name> meas,</l>
  <l n="485">ausus es ante oculos adducta paelice nostros</l>
  <l n="486">tam bene compositum sollicitare torum?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="487">heu ubi pacta fides? ubi quae iurare solebas?</l>
  <l n="488">me miseram, quotiens haec ego verba loquar?</l>
  <l n="489"><persName>Thesea</persName> culpabas fallacemque ipse vocabas:</l>
  <l n="490">iudicio peccas turpius ipse tuo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="491">ne sciat haec quisquam tacitisque doloribus urar,</l>
  <l n="492">ne totiens falli digna fuisse puter.</l>
  <l n="493">praecipue cupiam celari <persName>Thesea</persName>, ne te</l>
</lg>
morceaux.19:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="493">consortem culpae gaudeat esse suae.</l>
  <l n="494">at, puto, praeposita est fuscae mihi candida paelex!</l>
  <l n="495">eveniat nostris hostibus ille color.</l>
  <l n="496">quid tamen hoc refert? vitio tibi gratior ipso est.</l>
  <l n="497">quid facis? amplexus inquinat illa tuos.</l>
  <l n="498">Bacche, fidem praesta, nec praefer amoribus ullam</l>
  <l n="499">coniugis: adsuevi semper amare virum.</l>
  <l n="500">ceperunt matrem formosi cornua tauri,</l>
  <l n="501"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">me</name> tua; at hic laudi est, ille pudendus amor.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="502">ne noceat quod amo: neque enim tibi, Bacche, nocebat</l>
  <l n="503">quod flammas nobis fassus es ipse tuas.</l>
  <l n="504">nec, quod nos uris, mirum facis: ortus in <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">igne</name></l>
  <l n="505">diceris, et patria raptus ab <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">igne</name> manu.</l>
  <l n="506">illa ego sum cui tu solitus promittere caelum.</l>
  <l n="507">ei mihi, pro caelo qualia dona fero!'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="508">dixerat; audibat iamdudum verba querentis</l>
  <l n="509"><persName>Liber</persName>, ut a tergo forte secutus erat.</l>
  <l n="510">occupat amplexu lacrimasque per oscula siccat,</l>
  <l n="511">et 'pariter caeli summa petamus' ait:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="512">tu mihi iuncta toro mihi iuncta vocabula sumes,</l>
  <l n="513">nam tibi mutatae <persName>Libera</persName> nomen erit,</l>
  <l n="514">sintque tuae tecum faciam monimenta coronae,</l>
  <l n="515">Volcanus <persName>Veneri</persName> quam dedit, illa tibi.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="516">dicta facit, gemmasque novem transformat in ignes:</l>
  <l n="517">aurea per stellas nunc micat illa novem.</l>
</lg>
<pb n="9"/>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l>(<foreign xml:lang="la">DC</foreign>)</l>
  <l>(<foreign xml:lang="la">EC</foreign>)</l>
  <l>(<foreign xml:lang="la">FC</foreign>)</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l>(<foreign xml:lang="la">GC</foreign>)</l>
  <l>(<foreign xml:lang="la">H EN</foreign>)</l>
  <l>(<foreign xml:lang="la">A EQVIRR</foreign> : <foreign xml:lang="la">NP</foreign>)</l>
</lg>
morceaux.20:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="516">Sex ubi sustulerit, totidem demerserit orbes</l>
  <l n="517"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">purpureum</name> rapido qui vehit <foreign xml:lang="la">axem</foreign> <name type="deity">diem</name>,</l>
  <l n="518">altera <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">gramineo</name> spectabis <foreign xml:lang="la">Equirria</foreign> <name type="placeName">Campo</name>,</l>
  <l n="519">quem <name type="placeName">Tiberis</name> curvis in latus urget <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aquis</name>;</l>
  <pb n="15"/>
  <l n="520">qui tamen eiecta si forte tenebitur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">unda</name>,</l>
  <l n="521"><name type="placeName">Caelius</name> accipiat pulverulentus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equos</name>.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.21:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="521">Idibus est Annae festum geniale Perennae</l>
  <l n="522">non procul a ripis, advena Thybri, tuis.</l>
  <l n="523">plebs venit ac virides passim disiecta per herbas</l>
  <l n="524">potat, et accumbit cum pare quisque sua.</l>
  <l n="525">sub Iove pars durat, pauci tentoria ponunt,</l>
  <l n="526">sunt quibus e ramis frondea facta casa est;</l>
  <l n="527">pars, ubi pro rigidis calamos statuere columnis,</l>
  <l n="528">desuper extentas imposuere togas.</l>
  <l n="529">sole tamen vinoque calent annosque precantur</l>
  <l n="530">quot sumant cyathos, ad numerumque bibunt.</l>
  <l n="531">invenies illic qui Nestoris ebibat annos,</l>
  <l n="532">quae sit per calices facta Sibylla suos.</l>
  <l n="533">illic et cantant quicquid didicere theatris,</l>
  <l n="534">et iactant faciles ad sua verba manus,</l>
  <l n="535">et ducunt posito duras cratere choreas,</l>
  <l n="536">cultaque diffusis saltat amica comis.</l>
  <l n="537">cum redeunt, titubant et sunt spectacula volgi,</l>
  <l n="538">et fortunatos obvia turba vocat.</l>
  <l n="539">occurrit nuper (visa est mihi digna relatu)</l>
  <l n="540">pompa: senem potum pota trahebat anus.</l>
  <l n="541">quae tamen haec dea sit quoniam rumoribus errat,</l>
  <l n="542">fabula proposito nulla tegenda meo.</l>
  <l n="543">arserat Aeneae Dido miserabilis igne,</l>
  <l n="544">arserat exstructis in sua fata rogis,</l>
  <l n="545">compositusque cinis, tumulique in marmore carmen</l>
  <l n="546">hoc breve, quod moriens ipsa reliquit, erat:</l>
  <l n="547">praebvit Aeneas et cavsam mortis et ensem:</l>
  <l n="548">ipsa sva Dido concidit vsa manv.</l>
  <l n="549">protinus invadunt Numidae sine vindice regnum,</l>
  <l n="550">et potitur capta Maurus Iarba domo,</l>
  <l n="551">seque memor spretum 'thalamis tamen' inquit 'Elissae</l>
  <l n="552">en ego, quem totiens reppulit illa, fruor.'</l>
</lg>
morceaux.22:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="555">diffugiunt <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Tyrii</name> quo quemque agit error, ut olim</l>
  <l n="556">amisso dubiae rege vagantur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">apes</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="557">tertia nudandas acceperat area messes,</l>
  <l n="558">inque cavos ierant tertia musta lacus:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="559">pellitur <persName>Anna</persName> domo, lacrimansque sororia linquit</l>
  <l n="560">moenia; germanae iusta dat ante suae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="561">mixta bibunt molles lacrimis unguenta favillae,</l>
  <l n="562">vertice libatas accipiuntque comas,</l>
  <l n="563">terque 'vale' dixit, cineres ter ad ora relatos</l>
  <l n="564">pressit, et est illis visa subesse soror.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="565">nacta ratem comitesque fugae pede labitur aequo</l>
  <l n="566">moenia respiciens, dulce sororis opus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="567">fertilis est <placeName>Melite</placeName> sterili vicina <placeName>Cosyrae</placeName></l>
  <l n="568">insula, quam <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Libyci</name> verberat unda freti.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="569">hanc petit, hospitio regis confisa vetusto:</l>
  <l n="570">hospes opum dives rex ibi <persName>Battus</persName> erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="571">qui postquam didicit casus utriusque sororis,</l>
  <l n="572">'haec' inquit 'tellus quantulacumque tua est.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="573">et tamen hospitii servasset ad ultima munus;</l>
  <l n="574">sed timuit magnas <persName>Pygmalionis</persName> opes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="575">signa recensuerat bis sol sua, tertius ibat</l>
  <l n="576">annus, et exilio terra paranda nova est.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="577">frater adest belloque petit. rex arma perosus</l>
  <l n="578">'nos sumus inbelles, tu fuge sospes' ait.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="579">iussa fugit ventoque ratem committit et undis:</l>
  <l n="580">asperior quovis aequore frater erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="581">est prope piscosos lapidosi <placeName>Crathidis</placeName> amnes</l>
  <l n="582">parvus ager, <placeName>Cameren</placeName> incola turba vocat:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="583">illuc cursus erat. nec longius abfuit inde</l>
  <l n="584">quam quantum novies mittere funda potest:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="585">vela cadunt primo et dubia librantur ab aura:</l>
  <l n="586">'findite remigio' navita dixit 'aquas';</l>
</lg>
morceaux.23:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="585">dumque parant <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">torto</name> subducere carbasa lino,</l>
  <l n="586">  percutitur rapido puppis adunca <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Noto</name>,</l>
  <l n="587">inque patens aequor, frustra pugnante magistro,</l>
  <l n="588">  fertur, et ex oculis visa refugit humus.</l>
  <l n="590">adsiliunt fluctus imoque a gurgite pontus</l>
  <l n="591">  vertitur, et canas alveus haurit aquas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="592">vincitur ars vento nec iam moderator habenis</l>
  <l n="593">  utitur, at votis is quoque poscit opem.</l>
  <l n="594">iactatur tumidas exul <persName>Phoenissa</persName> per undas,</l>
  <l n="595">  umidaque opposita lumina veste tegit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="596">tum primum <persName>Dido</persName> felix est dicta sorori</l>
  <l n="597">  et quaecumque aliquam corpore pressit humum.</l>
  <l n="598">ducitur ad <placeName>Laurens</placeName> ingenti flamine litus</l>
  <l n="599">  puppis, et expositis omnibus hausta perit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="600">iam pius <persName>Aeneas</persName> regno nataque <persName>Latini</persName></l>
  <l n="601">  auctus erat, populos miscueratque duos.</l>
  <l n="602">litore dotali solo comitatus <persName>Achate</persName></l>
  <l n="603">  secretum nudo dum pede carpit iter,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="604">aspicit errantem, nec credere sustinet <persName>Ann</persName></l>
  <l n="605">  esse: quid in Latios illa veniret agros?</l>
  <l n="606">dum secum <persName>Aeneas</persName>, 'Anna est!' exclamat <persName>Achates</persName>:</l>
  <l n="607">  ad nomen voltus sustulit illa suos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="608">heu, quid agat? fugiat? quos terrae quaerat hiatus?</l>
  <l n="609">  ante oculos miserae fata sororis erant.</l>
  <l n="610">sensit, et adloquitur trepidam <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Cythereius</name> heros</l>
  <l n="611">  (flet tamen admonitu motus, <persName>Elissa</persName>, tui):</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="612">'Anna, per hanc iuro, quam quondam audire solebas</l>
  <l n="613">  tellurem fato prosperiore dari,</l>
  <l n="614">perque deos comites, hac nuper sede locatos,</l>
  <l n="615">  saepe meas illos increpuisse moras.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="616">nec timui de morte tamen: metus abfuit iste.</l>
  <l n="617">  ei mihi, credibili fortior illa fuit.</l>
  <l n="618">ne refer: aspexi non illo corpore digna</l>
</lg>
morceaux.24:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="620">volnera Tartareas <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ausus</name> adire domos.</l>
  <l n="621">at tu, seu ratio te nostris adpulit oris</l>
  <l n="622">sive deus, regni commoda carpe mei.</l>
  <l n="623">multa tibi memores, nil non debemus <persName>Elissae</persName>:</l>
  <l n="624">nomine grata tuo, grata sororis eris.'</l>
  <l n="625">talia dicenti (neque enim spes altera restat)</l>
  <l n="626">credidit, errores exposuitque suos;</l>
  <l n="627">utque domum intravit <placeName>Tyrios</placeName> induta paratus,</l>
  <l n="628">incipit <persName>Aeneas</persName> (cetera turba tacet):</l>
  <l n="629">'hanc tibi cur tradam, pia causa, <persName>Lavinia</persName> coniunx,</l>
  <l n="630">est mihi: consumpsi naufragus huius opes.</l>
  <l n="631">orta <placeName>Tyro</placeName> est, regnum <placeName>Libyca</placeName> possedit in ora:</l>
  <l n="632">quam precor ut carae more sororis ames.'</l>
  <l n="633">omnia promittit falsumque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">volnus</name></l>
  <l n="634">mente premit tacita dissimulatque metus;</l>
  <l n="635">donaque cum videat praeter sua lumina ferri</l>
  <l n="636">multa, tamen mitti clam quoque multa putat.</l>
  <l n="637">non habet exactum quid agat: furialiter odit,</l>
  <l n="638">et parat insidias et cupit ulta mori.</l>
  <l n="639">nox erat: ante torum visa est adstare sororis</l>
  <l n="640">squalenti <persName>Dido</persName> sanguinulenta coma</l>
  <l n="641">et 'fuge, ne dubita, maestum fuge' dicere 'tectum';</l>
  <l n="642">sub verbum querulas impulit aura fores.</l>
  <l n="643">exsilit et velox humili <foreign xml:lang="la">super</foreign> ausa fenestra</l>
  <l n="644">se iacit (audacem fecerat ipse timor),</l>
  <l n="645">cumque metu rapitur tunica velata recincta,</l>
  <l n="646">currit ut auditis territa <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">damma</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lupis</name>,</l>
  <l n="647">corniger hanc cupidis rapuisse <placeName>Numicius</placeName> undis</l>
  <l n="648">creditur et stagnis occuluisse suis.</l>
  <l n="649"><placeName>Sidonis</placeName> interea magno clamore per agros</l>
  <l n="650">quaeritur: apparent signa notaeque pedum;</l>
  <l n="651">ventum erat ad ripas: inerant vestigia ripis;</l>
</lg>
morceaux.25:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="654">sustinuit tacitas conscius amnis aquas.</l>
  <l n="655">ipsa loqui visa est 'placidi sum <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">nympha</name> <placeName>Numici</placeName>:</l>
  <l n="656">amne perenne latens <persName>Anna Perenna</persName> vocor.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="657">protinus erratis laeti vescuntur in agris</l>
  <l n="658">et celebrant largo seque diemque mero.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="659">Sunt quibus haec <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Luna</name> est, quia mensibus impleat annum;</l>
  <l n="660">pars <persName>Themin</persName>, <persName>Inachiam</persName> pars putat esse <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">bovem</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="661">invenies qui te <persName>nymphen</persName> <placeName>Azanida</placeName> dicant</l>
  <l n="662">teque <persName>Iovi</persName> primos, <persName>Anna</persName>, dedisse cibos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="663">haec quoque, quam referam, nostras pervenit ad aures</l>
  <l n="664">fama, nec a veri dissidet illa fide.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="665">plebs vetus et nullis etiam nunc tuta tribunis</l>
  <l n="666">fugit et in <placeName>Sacri</placeName> vertice <placeName>Montis</placeName> erat;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="667">iam quoque quem secum tulerant defecerat illos</l>
  <l n="668">victus et humanis usibus apta <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">Ceres</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="669">orta suburbanis quaedam fuit <persName>Anna</persName> <placeName>Bovillis</placeName>,</l>
  <l n="670">pauper, sed multae sedulitatis anus;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="671">illa, levi mitra canos incincta capillos,</l>
  <l n="672">fingebat tremula rustica liba manu,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="673">atque ita per populum fumantia mane solebat</l>
  <l n="674">dividere: haec populo copia grata fuit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="675">pace domi facta signum posuere <persName>Perennae</persName>,</l>
  <l n="676">quod sibi defectis illa ferebat opem.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="677">Nunc mihi, cur cantent, superest, obscena puellae,</l>
  <l n="678">dicere; nam coeunt certaque probra canunt.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="679">nuper erat dea facta: venit <persName>Gradivus</persName> ad <persName>Ann</persName>,</l>
  <l n="680">et cum seducta talia verba facit:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="681">'mense meo coleris, iunxi mea tempora tecum;</l>
  <l n="682">pendet ab officio spes mihi magna tuo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="683"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">armifer</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">armiferae</name> correptus amore <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Minervae</name></l>
  <l n="684">uror, et hoc longo tempore volnus alo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="685">effice, di studio similes coeamus in unum:</l>
</lg>
morceaux.26:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="684">conveniunt partes hae tibi, comis anus.'</l>
  <l n="685">dixerat; illa deum promisso ludit inani,</l>
  <l n="686">et stultam dubia spem trahit usque mora.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="687">saepius instanti 'mandata peregimus' inquit;</l>
  <l n="688">'evicta est: precibus vix dedit illa manus.'</l>
  <l n="689">credit amans thalamosque parat. deducitur illuc</l>
  <l n="690">Anna tegens voltus, ut nova nupta, suos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="691">oscula sumpturus subito Mars aspicit Annam:</l>
  <l n="692">nunc pudor elusum, nunc subit ira, deum.</l>
  <l n="693">ridet amatorem carae nova diva Minervae,</l>
  <l n="694">nec res hac Veneri gratior ulla fuit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="695">inde ioci veteres obscenaque dicta canuntur,</l>
  <l n="696">et iuvat hanc magno verba dedisse deo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="697">Praeteriturus eram gladios in principe fixos,</l>
  <l n="698">cum sic a castis Vesta locuta focis:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="699">'ne dubita meminisse: meus fuit ille sacerdos;</l>
  <l n="700">sacrilegae telis me petiere manus.</l>
  <l n="701">ipsa virum rapui simulacraque nuda reliqui:</l>
  <l n="702">quae cecidit ferro, Caesaris umbra fuit.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="703">ille quidem caelo positus Iovis atria vidit,</l>
  <l n="704">et tenet in magno templa dicata foro;</l>
  <l n="705">at quicumque nefas ausi, prohibente deorum</l>
  <l n="706">numine, polluerant pontificale caput,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="707">morte iacent merita: testes estote, Philippi,</l>
  <l n="708">et quorum sparsis ossibus albet humus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="709">hoc opus, haec pietas, haec prima elementa fuerunt</l>
  <l n="710">Caesaris, ulcisci iusta per arma patrem.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="16">Postera cum teneras aurora refecerit herbas,</l>
  <l n="17">Scorpios a prima parte videndus erit.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.27: Halieutica Tertia post Idus lux est celeberrima Baccho: Bacche, fave vati, dum tua festa cano. nec referam Semelen, ad quam nisi fulmina secum Iuppiter adferret, ~parvus inermis eras~; nec, puer ut posses maturo tempore nasci, expletum patrio corpore matris opus. Sithonas et Scythicos longum narrare triumphos et domitas gentes, turifer Inde, tuas. tu quoque Thebanae mala praeda tacebere matris, inque tuum furiis acte Lycurge genus. ecce libet subitos pisces Tyrrhenaque monstra dicere; sed non est carminis huius opus. carminis huius opus causas exponere quare vitisator populos ad sua liba vocet. ante tuos ortus arae sine honore fuerunt, Liber, et in gelidis herba reperta focis. te memorant, Gange totoque Oriente subacto, primitias magno seposuisse Iovi: cinnama tu primus captivaque tura dedisti deque triumphato viscera tosta bove. nomine ab auctoris ducunt libamina nomen libaque, quod sanctis pars datur inde focis; liba deo fiunt, sucis quia dulcibus idem gaudet, et a Baccho mella reperta ferunt. ibat harenoso satyris comitatus ab Hebro (non habet ingratos fabula nostra iocos); iamque erat ad Rhodopen Pangaeaque florida ventum: aeriferae comitum concrepuere manus. ecce novae coeunt volucres tinnitibus actae, quosque movent sonitus aera, sequuntur apes; colligit errantes et in arbore claudit inani Liber, et inventi praemia mellis habet.
morceaux.28:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="745">ut <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">satyri</name> levisque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">senex</name> tetigere saporem</l>
  <l n="746">quaerebant flavos per nemus omne favos.</l>
  <l n="747">audit in exesa stridorem <foreign xml:lang="la">examinis</foreign> <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">ulmo</name>,</l>
  <l n="748">aspicit et ceras dissimulatque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">senex</name>;</l>
  <l n="749">utque piger pandi tergo residebat <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aselli</name>,</l>
  <l n="750">adplicat hunc <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">ulmo</name> corticibusque cavis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="751">constitit ipse super ramoso stipite nixus,</l>
  <l n="752">atque avide trunco condita mella petit:</l>
  <l n="753">milia <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">crabronum</name> coeunt, et vertice nudo</l>
  <l n="754">spicula defigunt oraque sima notant.</l>
  <l n="755">ille cadit praeceps et calce feritur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aselli</name>,</l>
  <l n="756">inclamatque suos auxiliumque rogat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="757">concurrunt <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">satyri</name> turgentiaque ora parentis</l>
  <l n="758">rident: percusso claudicat ille genu.</l>
  <l n="759">ridet et ipse <name type="deity">deus</name>, limumque inducere monstrat;</l>
  <l n="760">hic paret monitis et linit ora luto.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="761">melle <name type="deity">pater</name> fruitur, liboque infusa calenti</l>
  <l n="762">iure repertori splendida mella damus.</l>
  <l n="763">femina cur praesit, non est rationis opertae:</l>
  <l n="746">femineos <foreign xml:lang="la">thyrso</foreign> concitat ille choros.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="765">cur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">anus</name> hoc faciat, quaeris? vinosior aetas</l>
  <l n="766">~haec erat et~ gravidae munera <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">vitis</name> amat.</l>
  <l n="767">cur <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">hedera</name> cincta est? <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">hedera</name> est gratissima <name type="deity">Baccho</name>;</l>
  <l n="768">hoc quoque cur ita sit, discere nulla mora est.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="769"><name type="deity">Nysiadas</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">nymphas</name> <name type="person">puerum</name> quaerente <name type="person">noverca</name></l>
  <l n="770">hanc frondem cunis opposuisse ferunt.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="771">Restat ut inveniam quare toga libera detur</l>
  <l n="772"><name type="person">Lucifero</name> pueris, candide <name type="deity">Bacche</name>, tuo:</l>
  <l n="773">sive quod ipse <name type="person">puer</name> semper iuvenisque videris,</l>
  <l n="774">et media est aetas inter utrumque tibi;</l>
  <l n="775">seu quia tu <name type="deity">pater</name> es, patres sua pignora, natos,</l>
  <l n="776">commendat curae numinibusque tuis:</l>
</lg>
morceaux.29:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="779">sive, quod es Liber, vestis quoque libera per te</l>
  <l n="780">sumitur et vitae liberioris iter:</l>
  <l n="781">an quia, cum colerent prisci studiosius agros,</l>
  <l n="782">et faceret patrio rure senator opus,</l>
  <l n="783">et caperet fasces a curvo consul aratro,</l>
  <l n="784">nec crimen duras esset habere manus,</l>
  <l n="785">rusticus ad ludos populus veniebat in Urbem—</l>
  <l n="786">sed dis, non studiis ille dabatur honor:</l>
  <l n="787">luce sua ludos uvae commentor habebat,</l>
  <l n="788">quos cum taedifera nunc habet ille <name type="deity">dea</name>—</l>
  <l n="789">ergo ut tironem celebrare frequentia possit,</l>
  <l n="790">visa dies dandae non aliena togae?</l>
  <l n="791">mite caput, pater, huc placataque cornua vertas,</l>
  <l n="792">et des ingenio vela secunda meo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="793">Itur ad <placeName>Argeos</placeName> (qui sint, sua pagina dicet)</l>
  <l n="794">hac, si commemini, praeteritaque die.</l>
  <l n="795">stella <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Lycaoniam</name> vergit declinis ad <foreign xml:lang="la">Arcton</foreign></l>

  <l n="797">quid dederit volucri, si vis cognoscere, caelum,</l>
  <l n="798"><name type="deity">Saturnus</name> regnis a <persName>Iove</persName> pulsus erat;</l>
  <l n="799">concitat iratus validos <name type="deity">Titanas</name> in arma,</l>

</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="801">matre satus <name type="deity">Terra</name>, monstrum mirabile, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">taurus</name></l>

  <l n="807">immolat hunc <persName>Briareus</persName> facta ex adamante securi,</l>
  <l n="808">et iamiam flammis exta daturus erat:</l>
  <l n="809"><persName>Iuppiter</persName> alitibus rapere imperat: attulit illi</l>

morceaux.30:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">Una dies media est, et fiunt sacra <name type="deity">Minervae</name>,</l>
  <l n="2">nomina quae iunctis quinque diebus habent.</l>
  <l n="3">sanguine prima vacat, nec fas concurrere ferro:</l>
  <l n="4">causa, quod est illa nata <name type="deity">Minerva</name> die.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="5">altera tresque super rasa celebrantur harena:</l>
  <l n="6">ensis<foreign xml:lang="la">bus</foreign> exsertis bellica laeta dea est.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="7"><name type="deity">Pallada</name> nunc pueri teneraeque orate puellae;</l>
  <l n="8">qui bene placarit <name type="deity">Pallada</name>, doctus erit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="9"><name type="deity">Pallade</name> placata lanam mollire puellae</l>
  <l n="10">discant et plenas exonerare colos.</l>
  <l n="11">illa etiam stantes radio percurrere telas</l>
  <l n="12">erudit et rarum pectine denset opus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="13">hanc cole, qui maculas laesis de vestibus aufers:</l>
  <l n="14">hanc cole, velleribus quisquis aena paras.</l>
  <l n="15">nec quisquam invita faciet bene vincula plantae</l>
  <l n="16"><name type="deity">Pallade</name>, sit <persName>Tychio</persName> doctior ille licet:</l>
  <l n="17">et licet antiquo manibus conlatus <persName>Epeo</persName></l>
  <l n="18">sit prior, irata <name type="deity">Pallade</name> mancus erit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="19">vos quoque, <name type="deity">Phoebea</name> morbos qui pellitis arte,</l>
  <l n="20">munera de vestris pauca referte deae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="21">nec vos, turba fere censu fraudata, magistri,</l>
  <l n="22">spernite (discipulos attrahit illa novos),</l>
  <l n="23">quique moves caelum, tabulamque coloribus uris,</l>
  <l n="24">quique facis docta mollia saxa manu.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="25">mille dea est operum: certe dea carminis illa est;</l>
  <l n="26">si mereor, studiis adsit amica meis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="27"><persName>Caelius</persName> ex alto qua mons descendit in aequum,</l>
  <l n="28">hic, ubi non plana est, sed prope plana via,</l>
  <l n="29">parva licet videas <placeName>Captae</placeName> delubra <name type="deity">Minervae</name>,</l>
  <l n="30">quae dea natali coepit habere suo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="31">nominis in dubio causa est. capitale vocamus</l>
  <l n="32">ingenium sollers: ingeniosa dea est.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.31:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="841">an quia de capitis fertur sine matre paterni</l>
  <l n="842">vertice cum clipeo prosiluisse suo?</l>
  <l n="843">an quia perdomitis ad nos captiva Faliscis</l>
  <l n="844">uenit? et hoc signo littera prisca docet.</l>
  <l n="845">an quod habet legem, capitis quae pendere poenas</l>
  <l n="846">ex illo iubeat furta recepta loco?</l>
  <l n="847">a quacumque trahis ratione vocabula, Pallas,</l>
  <l n="848">pro ducibus nostris aegida semper habe.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.32:
Summa dies e quinque tubas lustrare canoras admonet et forti sacrificare deae. nunc potes ad solem sublato dicere voltu 'hic here Phrixeae vellera pressit ovis.' seminibus tostis sceleratae fraude novercae sustulerat nullas, ut solet, herba comas: mittitur ad tripodas certa qui sorte reportet quam sterili terrae Delphicus edat opem. hic quoque corruptus cum semine nuntiat Helles et iuvenis Phrixi funera sorte peti. usque recusantem cives et tempus et Ino compulerunt regem iussa nefanda pati; et soror et Phrixus, velati tempora vittis, stant simul ante aras iunctaque fata gemunt. aspicit hos, ut forte pependerat aethere, mater et ferit attonita pectora nuda manu, inque draconigenam nimbis comitantibus urbem desilit, et natos eripit inde suos; utque fugam capiant, aries nitidissimus auro traditur: ille vehit per freta longa duos. dicitur infirma cornu tenuisse sinistra femina, cum de se nomina fecit aquae. paene simul periit, dum volt succurrere lapsae, frater, et extentas porrigit usque manus. flebat, ut amissa gemini consorte pericli, caeruleo iunctam nescius esse deo. litoribus tactis aries fit sidus; at huius pervenit in Colchas aurea lana domos.
